lines.text: Wait! Why Cutting 1 Onion Makes Your Eyes Cry in 10 Seconds!
Most kids guess totally wrong about why onions make you cry!
Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
Slicing onion cells mixes enzymes and sulfur compounds into an invisible gas.
that floats to your eyes and triggers tears to wash the eyes clean.
Nature uses amazing science tricks right under our noses!
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
Now you know the real truth behind Onion Tears!
